```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 14_anova_notation_learning_checks
title: >
  Learning Checks
questions:
  - id: condition_variance
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      The variance of scores in each treatment condition is most directly part of
      which source?
    options:
      - text: >
          Within-treatment variability
        correct: true
      - text: >
          Grand total only
      - text: >
          The treatment total
      - text: >
          The number of factors
    explanation: >
      Within-treatment variability describes how scores vary inside each group.

  - id: total_n_symbol
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      The total number of scores recorded in the study is usually symbolized as:
    options:
      - text: >
          $N$
        correct: true
      - text: >
          $n$
      - text: >
          $T$
      - text: >
          $SS$
    explanation: >
      Uppercase N refers to the total number of scores.

  - id: t_numerator_concept
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      Which ANOVA component is conceptually closest to the numerator of the
      independent-samples t statistic?
    options:
      - text: >
          Between-groups variability
        correct: true
      - text: >
          Within-groups variability
      - text: >
          Total sample size
      - text: >
          The p-value
    explanation: >
      Both capture observed differences among treatment means.
```
